units.en: ⟦0⟧ is a releasable "country" that can appear inside the ⟦1⟧. It appears via decisions after completing the ⟦2⟧ national focus, or as a result of an event-chain following foreign occupation of ⟦3⟧ territory if it has the ⟦4⟧ national spirit and ⟦5⟧ is enabled.

The Holwell Monument agitation was a political campaign led by Subhas Chandra Bose in 1940 to remove a monument to the Black Hole of Calcutta (now Kolkata). The agitation marked a significant moment of unity between Hindu nationalists and the All-India Muslim League. On 2 July 1940, Subhas Chandra Bose was arrested under the Defence of India Act of 1939 for calling for a Siraj-ud-Daulah Day coinciding with the 183rd anniversary of the latter's execution by Mir Jafar under orders from the East India Company. To prevent further agitation, Bengal Governor John Herbert quietly dismantled the monument. After a seven-day hunger strike, Bose was moved from the city's Presidency Jail to house arrest on 5 December, at which point he escaped to Nazi Germany, never to return to India.
Main article: Generic national focus tree
⟦0⟧, lacking a unique national focus tree, uses the generic national focus tree instead.
The generic focus tree has 5 main branches:
Gives army experience and research bonuses to army research.
Gives air experience, builds air bases, and research bonuses to air research.
Gives navy experience, builds naval dockyards, and research bonuses to navy research.
Builds civilian and military factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants extra research slots.
Gives the country choices on which political path they will take.

⟦0⟧ starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
When released, ⟦0⟧ will start as a Non Aligned nation that does not have elections.

The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

The "Indian Partisans", despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is almost unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands. In order to play as early as the Indian Partisans, is to play first as the British Raj and go with the Onto the road of Independence focus path. In this case, rush and take the League against Gandhism, Forward Bloc and finally Protest Against The Holwell Monument. As the British Raj has been destabilized further, use console commands to switch to the "Indian Partisans" tag to play as them. Usually, Indian Partisans start in east Indian cores, and at various times in the middle of Indian cores.

Now, should the British Raj stall for a bit, the first thing you should do is take the first Political focus, which will give you 120 political power, plus the 70 you have already accumulated. Use this to get a fascist advisor. Yes, I know, going fascist is the go-to strategy for basically every minor, but if it works, it works. While you wait for fascist support to tick up, take some industrial focuses to get some free factories. Grab the two free civilian factories first, then get the three military factories. By this time you should be above fifty percent fascist support, so hold a referendum to become fascist. Use your excess political power to get war economy, and if you have any extra left, get some Improved Worker Conditions or Anti-Communist/Democratic raids. Otherwise, if your manpower is still an issue you can go communist to get to the weekly manpower army experience. Since Indian states have an abundance of population, this would not be a problem.

By now you should have a total of 4 or 5 factories- 2 civilian and 3 military, more or less, depending on what core that you start in. One of your civilian factories will be used for consumer goods, so use the remaining one to either build some more civs or trade for some steel. Use one of your 3 military factories to produce artillery, and use the other 2 to build guns. Set some factories to build support equipment as well once you get some more mils.

At this point, you should've flipped fascist already, so start justifying on Bhutan. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Be sure to go for naval factories, and make submarines for naval invasions. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. Should you declare on Tibet, Nepal, Burma or god forbid, India and win against them each other can give you enough expansion and access to some valuable resources.

At the start of the game, get both a ⟦0⟧ demagogue and a ⟦1⟧ revolutionary and switch to ⟦2⟧ via civil war. This will allow you to quickly get manpower bonuses from the ⟦3⟧ political tree as well as joining the ⟦4⟧ to avoid a ⟦5⟧ attack, while ⟦6⟧ support builds up for later (remove the ⟦7⟧ demagogue after your civil war but ensure ⟦8⟧ support stays below 60% to avoid a second civil war).

Build up your army to about 15 infantry divisions to naval invade southern ⟦0⟧. Produce cheap submarines to ensure naval supremacy and create some cavalry divisions for defending your ports against naval invasions and at the ⟦1⟧ border, which can also be built up with forts.

Declare war on ⟦0⟧ after your ⟦1⟧ support reaches 50%, then call in your allies and switch to . With ⟦2⟧ support, capitulating ⟦3⟧ should be straightforward and they will likely attack through your border rather than navally invading allowing for you to occupy all the land including Stockholm.

You can also do this without joining any faction. Just turn either ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. It doesn't really matter which. After that fabricate a war goal against ⟦2⟧ and put a few divisions on a naval invasion order for the Svealand province. You only need Stockholm for the achievement. ⟦3⟧ should have put most of their divisions on your border, but only rarely do they put any in Stockholm. Once the war starts you should have naval supremacy for a few hours. Enough for your invasions to be able to be launched. Even if ⟦4⟧ intercepts one divisions, they never will be able to get them all. So once you land either directly in Stockholm or land near it and then take it, the achievement pops up.
